items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries; counsel_required for any rights-dependent launch, affiliate, advertising, or public-data decision. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution, storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, trademark/image/price use, or monetization rights; public terms restrict those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but none closes a task. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not close tasks without direct evidence or send rights outreach before human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Fleet legal/compliance disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases where material controls or disclosures are unevidenced. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics quality is yellow because some permissions or collectors fail; this does not by itself block ordinary growth. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon results, including $4.92 commission that is not site-attributable. Do not make site-level revenue, ROI, margin, causal-lift, or monetization claims.

Parked scaffold sites remain blocked for public launch and preview publication. Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. Next evidence action: attach a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker by 2026-09-30T17:00Z. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue entries before the packet and required gates are complete.

Retain containment-only execution this cycle. Active delivery is full at 10/10, with 59 overflow items, 38 improvements awaiting measurement, and 17 failed requests. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, finance reconciliation, security evidence, and parked-site readiness work. Do not create or requeue work, expand monetization, add telemetry, or conduct external outreach. The next evidence action is one verified completion or justified close with ownership, validation, rollback, release/security, attribution, and measurement evidence.
